name: easitaskmgnt
description: A small full-stack Task Manager assignment built with a Node.js API, Vue 3, and Tailwind CSS. Users can add tasks and view each task's current status in a responsive interface.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
